description: Publish a STATIC landing page to the brand's Vercel account from HTML (it becomes index.html) or a few files [{file, data, encoding:'utf-8'|'base64'}], up to 50 files and 4 MB. project names the Vercel project (created if it does not exist; it becomes part of the URL). target 'preview' (default) makes a new preview URL and leaves the live site alone; 'production' REPLACES what the project's domains serve. WITHOUT confirm:true nothing is sent and you get the exact preview to show the user; call again with confirm:true only after they say yes. The answer is Vercel's own deployment row (URL and state); a new deployment is QUEUED or BUILDING for a moment, so read it back with list_vercel_deployments deploymentId until READY. Free. Needs Vercel connected (Settings > Connectors > Vercel, or connect_connector with an access token).

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this exact deploy

files.description: instead of (or as well as) html: relative paths with their content

data.description: file content: text, or base64 text when encoding is base64

encoding.description: utf-8 (default) for text, or base64 for binary content

file.description: relative path inside the site, e.g. about/index.html; no leading slash and no ../

html.description: the full HTML of the page

name: deploy_vercel_page
title: Deploy a page to Vercel
